summary: Iteration 4: Full backend + frontend coverage of new Emergent Google auth flow and /reports feature. Seeded two mongo users/sessions and ran 19 pytest cases (100% pass) covering /api/auth/me unauth/authed/invalid, /api/reports auth-gated protection, full reports CRUD (create → list → get → patch notes → delete), cross-user isolation, logout invalidates session, and regression on public endpoints (health, models/comparison, eda, schema, predict, ablation/groups, training-history). Playwright covered: /login page + google-login-btn redirects to auth.emergentagent.com (with correct redirect param), /reports without cookie -> /login, /reports with seeded httpOnly cookie renders (shows user-email in header), toggling report row expands body, editing/saving notes persists (verified via API), delete row removes it, logout-btn works and re-visiting /reports redirects to /login. Regression pages /predict /batch /compare /lab /models /dashboard /about all load without page errors. Visual teal accent verified: header CTA (btn-ink) computed background is rgb(29,110,112) = #1D6E70, active Home nav link underline is teal, logo box is teal.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py POST /api/auth/session inserts a new user_sessions row every login without upserting on session_token — if Emergent reuses session_token the insert will still work (no unique index) but leaves duplicates. Consider $set-based upsert on session_token.

Reports.jsx uses window.confirm() for delete which is fine but blocks headless tests without dialog handler; already handled via page.once('dialog',...)—not a bug, just a UX note (a shadcn AlertDialog would be nicer).

SHAP-related recharts warnings ('width(-1) and height(-1)') on /predict, /models, /dashboard etc. Not blocking but indicates a ResponsiveContainer parent with no explicit min height in some cases. Cosmetic.
test_credentials: Seed via /app/auth_testing.md; Bearer token used: test_session_nephro_1 (user nephro-test@example.com). Cleaned up after run.
seed_data_creation: Created + cleaned up users test-user-nephro-1/2/3 and matching session tokens in test_database.users / test_database.user_sessions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Bearer-token auth works exactly per playbook (Cookie OR Authorization header via get_current_user in /app/backend/auth.py). Reports collection stores documents with report_id (uuid) and user_id filter. Frontend uses withCredentials for cookies; when testing manually seed session via mongosh from /app/memory/test_credentials.md and set the session_token cookie in the browser context. Frontend CTA / logo / active-nav use var(--accent) = #1D6E70.
